before_gpu_freeze: Root reviews the independent diagnostic report and explicitly selects this measurement correction using the predeclared primary inline conditioner rule, not candidate speed or descriptive phase maxima.
Freeze a separate new harness/build/reader/protocol manifest with exact SHA256 and CPU mutation-test results.
Freeze complete execution argv, actual effective config, immutable capture/library/source/binary identities, process/exclusivity observations and final fullmodel prerequisites.
activation_prerequisites.if_diagnostic_rule_fails: Do not run this cohort; archive draft. No additional sample, threshold change or alternate diagnostic phase selection.

relationship_to_previous_evidence.reason_for_new_protocol: Explicit measurement intervention aligns A1/A2 immediate GPU provider and output reuse, retaining original arithmetic, controls and gates.

frozen_inputs.config_contract: Captured deployed config bytes and complete effective environment; PREFIX_CACHE=1, PLD=1; no selector override.
frozen_inputs.model_request_scope: Same frozen first32768 captured tokens; one repeated-engineering request, not production workload distribution.

providers.args: captured original native ABI bytes; preserve original geometry/dynamic threadgroup memory
unchanged complete-TU canonical args; original replay geometry/dynamic threadgroup memory
unchanged complete-TU canonical args; original replay geometry/dynamic threadgroup memory

measurement.mode: concurrent one compute dispatch per command buffer, synchronous wait unchanged
measurement.numerical_and_topk_extra_command_buffers: Separate from 240; count and save independently.
measurement.output_resource_policy: Three stable provider-specific physical output buffers allocated once per layer before that layer timing groups, slot=actual provider. A1/A2 share the control slot; conditioner/B share candidate slot. No per-sample allocation or distinct-output alternative.
measurement.matched_control_condition: A1 and A2 both immediately follow a candidate CB. In every formal sample, both reuse their shared control output after exactly two compute dispatches: previous A2 -> conditioner -> A1; A1 -> B -> A2. The warmup seeds the first formal reuse history.
measurement.first_warmup_history: First warmup output history is not assumed initialized/matched; no warmup value enters performance statistics.
measurement.observer_policy: Fixed inline primary mode of the diagnostic, chosen before inspecting candidate savings: after every CB wait take complete score/guard CPU snapshots and run the same two complete comparisons, finite/causal/poison scan and SHA. Emit JSON and write raw only after all four CBs. No CPU verification sampling; conditioners have identical observation work.
measurement.poison_and_guards: Preserve frozen replay body poison each dispatch and original guard policy. Never repair or refill a damaged guard after a failing CB. Save failure outputs before refusing.
measurement.no_parameter_selection: Do not tune sample count, warmup, sleep, order, provider, slot policy, observer mode or thresholds using diagnostic candidate speed or this cohort results.
measurement.host_clock: Record host-host deltas using named host clock; calculate GPU-GPU intervals from Metal timestamps. Do not subtract across clock epochs without an independently established mapping.
measurement.timed_quantity: Each measured arm GPU CB span only. Conditioner duration and host observer duration are excluded from arm median speedup, yet recorded in full; no engine end-to-end speed claim.

every_record_including_conditioner: actual selected symbol/provider/ABI args/grid/threads/dynamic threadgroup bytes
global sequence and actual previous provider/output slot
stable output resource identity and reuse-distance witness
GPU start/end/span and host poison/commit/wait/snapshot/validation times with named clock
full raw score bytes and full leading/trailing guard bytes; SHA256; source paths
mismatches to captured actual and immutable TILED reference; finite/causal/poison/guard checks; no trust in emitted pass booleans
raw_evidence.full_inputs_before_and_after: All original Q/W/K cache and argument raw bytes plus guards, exact sizes and full SHA256; no input-only checksum claim.
raw_evidence.deduplication: Allowed only when complete bytes are preserved/materializable and full SHA and byte equality are verified; never sample or drop repeated records.
raw_evidence.failure_policy: Save all currently visible complete raw, input/guard post-state and failure reason, mark cohort invalid and stop. No performance interpretation or replacement samples.

correctness.before_any_formal_timing: Original all-three-layer, all-three-provider numerical and actual ordered Top512 gate must pass; no timing-only fallback.
correctness.actual_exact: Every actual-control output bit equals captured actual scores.
correctness.tiled_and_candidate: Every output bit equals immutable TILED reference, including canonical negative infinity; candidate equals TILED for every complete output, not tolerance.
correctness.exact_to_tiled_difference: Preserve original 4 L2 score-cell differences; report as a known provider difference, never label exact-to-TILED scores bit-identical.
correctness.actual_topk: Complete actual deployed Top512 ordered IDs for all three providers/layers match captured IDs before timing; preserve original raw TopK outputs and consumer configuration.
correctness.conditioners: All 60 complete candidate outputs and guards pass the same candidate numerical contract, have complete raw/SHA/timestamps, and remain excluded from performance statistics.
correctness.all_inputs_unchanged: Complete original input bytes and guards before/after exact.

performance.group_statistics: For each layer/control separately, A1=median(9 formal A1 gpu_us), B=median(9 formal B gpu_us), A2=median(9 formal A2 gpu_us). No pooling, trimming, best-of, paired-ratio substitution, warmup or conditioner inclusion.
performance.joint_pass: All identity/integrity/numerical/TopK/input/guard/exclusivity gates AND every one of the six drift and strict-savings gates pass.

interpretation_boundaries: This intervention matches immediate predecessor provider and logical output-reuse distance for A1 and A2; it does not match the immediate predecessor of measured B to those of A1/A2. B follows control, whereas A1/A2 follow candidate.
The added conditioner does not recreate ordinary full-model scheduling or establish a unique DVFS/cache/host mechanism.

GPU span saving applies only to this independently frozen conditioned component protocol. It is not intrinsic isolated-kernel proof, engine speedup, HTTP TTFT, stable decode speed, or production workload evidence.
A successful new cohort does not erase or reinterpret the original R2 failed joint gate and cannot be pooled with diagnosis.

The primary inline observer and fixed candidate conditioner are specified from control-stability hypotheses. Deferred/distinct diagnostic phases cannot be selected because they show a larger candidate saving.

after_joint_gate.if_any_gate_fails: Stop candidate progression; preserve complete failure. Do not run fullmodel or register candidate runtime from this result.
after_joint_gate.if_all_gates_pass: May prepare a separately authorized/frozen fullmodel native and HTTP A1/B/A2 gate; no runtime or production adoption from component success alone.
after_joint_gate.fullmodel_minimum: At least one warmup and three formal samples per A1/B/A2 arm, both required workloads, complete logits/tokens/output/state/bytes, prefill and decode separated, provider/symbol/adoption witnesses, exact effective production config and restoration; >2% fullmodel saving and frozen control drift gates.
after_joint_gate.fullmodel_driver_status: Prepared only, never executed with model/GPU at time of this draft.
